Tốc độ không chỉ thị

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Tốc độ không chỉ thị?

In this glossary, Tốc độ không chỉ thị refers to: The airspeed value read directly from the aircraft’s airspeed indicator, not corrected for instrument or atmospheric errors.

How is Tốc độ không chỉ thị used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Đồng hồ tốc độ chỉ thị 250 knot khi hạ độ cao qua mười nghìn feet."

Why does Tốc độ không chỉ thị matter in aviation?

Tốc độ không chỉ thị matters because it supports clear communication in Flight Phase contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Tốc độ không chỉ thị?

Tốc độ không chỉ thị is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Tốc độ không chỉ thị belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

The airspeed value read directly from the aircraft’s airspeed indicator, not corrected for instrument or atmospheric errors.

Operational example

The airspeed indicator showed an indicated airspeed of 250 knots during the descent through ten thousand feet.

Localized term

Localized example
